<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Bottle of Water|id=A0066}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Ordering a bottle of water is one thing; making fun at the same time is something completely different. JP and Liliana tell us all about it — and more! The keywords are: '''gas''' – carbonation and '''botella''' – bottle.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0003|A0003: At the bar]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0010|A0010: I'm hungry]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0023|A0023: Going to the market]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿Qué le doy?'''
| What shall I give you?
| '''¿Me da una botella de agua, por favor?'''
| Will you give me a bottle of water, please?
| '''¿Agua con gas o sin gas?'''
| Carbonated water or non-carbonated water?
| '''Sin gas porque me da gas.'''
| Non-carbonated because it gives me gas.
| '''Enseguida se la doy.'''
| I'll give it to you right away.
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thank you.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.

{{SbcNewline}}{{SbcNewline}}<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| What shall I give you?
| '''¿Qué le doy?'''
| Will you give me a bottle, please?
| '''¿Me da una botella, por favor?'''
| ¿A bottle? ¿A bottle of water or what?
| '''¿Una botella? ¿Una botella de agua o qué?'''
| Will you give me a bottle of gas, please?
| '''¿Me da una botella de gas, por favor?'''
| What? A bottle of carbonated water?
| '''¿Qué? ¿Una botella de agua con gas?'''
| Or a bottle of gas with water.
| '''O una botella de gas con agua.'''
| I'll give it to you right away.
| '''Enseguida se la doy.'''
| I give you the thanks. ({{=}} I thank you)
| '''Le doy las gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| What shall I give you?
| '''¿Qué le doy?'''
| Will you give me a bottle, please?
| '''¿Me da una botella, por favor?'''
| ¿A bottle? ¿A bottle of water or what?
| '''¿Una botella? ¿Una botella de agua o qué?'''
| Will you give me a bottle of gas, please?
| '''¿Me da una botella de gas, por favor?'''
| What? A bottle of carbonated water?
| '''¿Qué? ¿Una botella de agua con gas?'''
| Or a bottle of gas with water.
| '''O una botella de gas con agua.'''
| I'll give it to you right away.
| '''Enseguida se la doy.'''
| I give you the thanks. ({{=}} I thank you)
| '''Le doy las gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>
